role: History screen pushed from the Dashboard: paginated, grouped (Today/Yesterday/This Week/Last Week/month) list of archive index entries with session-type, tag and text filters (state held in HistoryViewModel), swipe-delete, Ask-Flo context action, and on-tap async load of the full session into MorningResultsView or FitnessPostSummaryView. It deletes (SessionTrash.move, declared here and the shared delete sequence), saves tags and sleep edits itself and shows an alert when any of those, or opening a reading, fails. Also declares historyDisplayScore, shared with HistoryCalendarView.
types: HistoryView.HistorySection: private struct — a section's newest date and entries
EntryHistoryRow: private struct (View) — row built from SessionArchiveEntry metadata only
SessionTrash: @MainActor enum — move(_:collector:cloudKit:), the one archive delete + notify + iCloud deletion sequence
state: global private var napBadge/quickBadge/breatheBadge (file-scope computed views)
toplevel: `@State private var viewModel = HistoryViewModel()` (line 19) uses the default init, which binds AppDependencies.current.storage.sessionArchive and settingsManager rather than the @Environment(\.dependencies) the view reads elsewhere; SwiftUI re-evaluates that initializer expression every time the HistoryView struct is re-created by DashboardV2View (historyDestination), building and discarding a HistoryViewModel. The stored onDelete/onUpdateTags closures are no longer called. #Preview builds HistoryView with no-op closures. Only production caller: DashboardV2View.swift historyDestination (MainTabView no longer passes delete/tag closures, so it gets DashboardV2View's no-op defaults).

flags.text: HistoryViewModel() default arguments read AppDependencies.current (global) for archive and settings while the view uses @Environment(\.dependencies) for CloudKit/assistant/settings; an injected environment (previews, snapshot tests at EmuquTests/RemainingScreenSnapshotTests.swift:38) still lists the global archive.

The delete sequence (archive.delete + notifyArchiveChanged + CloudKit uploadDeletion) now lives in SessionTrash.move, used by both History paths (MainTabView.deleteSession is gone), but TrendsV2View.deleteSession still carries its own copy (handoff from fix batch b22).

onDelete and onUpdateTags are stored but never called (History deletes through SessionTrash.move and saves tags in saveTags so it can report failures); they stay only until DashboardV2View, the #Preview and RemainingScreenSnapshotTests stop passing them (handoff from fix batch b22).
